questions.question: Which monitor behavior do you actually want? (Your prior session pivoted to option B; this thread you asked for option A.)

options.label: A) Auto-resume the paused sessions
options.description: Detect 429/usage-limit pause → wait for window to clear → spawn `claude --resume <sid> -p "continue"` for each paused session. More complex: need to choose the resume prompt, handle still-paused retries, surface results. What this thread asked for.

options.label: B) Just kill stuck workers when window clears
options.description: Detect 429/usage-limit pause → wait for window to clear → SIGTERM the stuck `claude ... --session-id` worker processes so the supervisor frees the slots and the cloud session list cleans up. Simpler. What your prior session pivoted to.

options.label: C) Both — kill workers, then auto-resume
options.description: Kill the stuck worker (so the supervisor's slot is freed), THEN spawn a `claude --resume` to continue the work in a fresh process. Combines both behaviors. Most useful but most complex.
